reden: Yes. The report explicitly flags the same TaikoL2 base fee bug: in anchor()/_calc1559BaseFee(), issuance is subtracted using numL1Blocks = _l1BlockId - lastSyncedBlock while lastSyncedBlock is only updated every 5 L1 blocks, so the same L1 blocks’ issuance is repeatedly applied across L2 blocks. This drives gasExcess down too fast and underprices the base fee (and can cause basefee mismatch/halts). Same code path, same root cause (stale lastSyncedBlock), and the same fix would address both descriptions.
